description: This file defines the internal class GrainLocator, which provides functionality for locating and managing grain activations within a distributed Orleans cluster. It includes methods for lookup, registration, unregistration, cache invalidation, and cache updating of grain addresses, making it a core component of the runtime's grain directory management.

classes.name: GrainLocator
classes.description: Provides functionality for locating grain activations in a cluster and registering the location of grain activations.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the address of a grain given its ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in the directory, optionally replacing previous registration.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from the directory with a specified cause.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a grain's address from the cache.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific grain ID or address.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates cache entries for a grain ID and silo address.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates cache based on a cache update object, invalidating or updating as appropriate.
